title: How a group grows and heals
claim: A policy changes the desired capacity, and the group launches, registers and replaces instances to keep that number.
alt: An architecture with users on the left, an Application Load Balancer, and an Auto Scaling group across two Availability Zones with one instance in each and a new instance starting. A CloudWatch alarm and a scaling policy sit above the group; a launch template sits beside it. Numbered arrows show the path.

edges.label: group metric
edges.say: CloudWatch alarms that the target tracking policy manages watch the group's metric.

edges.label: off target
edges.say: When the metric moves away from the target, the policy adjusts the desired capacity of the group.

edges.label: launch
edges.say: The group launches a new instance from its launch template in the Availability Zone with the fewest instances.

edges.label: register
edges.say: With a load balancer, the group registers your instance with the load balancer before it marks the instance as InService.

edges.label: replace
edges.say: The group terminates the unhealthy instance and launches another when an instance fails a check that the group uses: EC2 checks, and ELB checks after you turn them on.
